study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABRIM (Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory) is a healthy ageing cohort used to derive normative trajectories. PPP (Personalized Parkinson Project) is an independent cohort used for validation, comprising both healthy controls and Parkinson's disease patients.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Data utilised to derive the normative trajectories is part of the Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory (ABRIM) data collection" ... "To study the applicability of the R2* and χ normative models derived from the ABRIM datasets, an independent cohort with a similar imaging protocol, which is part of the 'Personalized Parkinson Project' (PPP) data collection"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Chan2025B.pdf.md: 2. MATERIAL AND METHODS / 2.1. Data acquisition

answer.ABRIM: normative model training and testing (deriving normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and χ)

answer.PPP: validation of normative models (healthy controls and Parkinson's disease patients for clinical application)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABRIM data (260 healthy subjects) were used to establish normative trajectories using Gaussian Process Regression with 10-fold cross-validation. PPP data (44 healthy controls and 316 Parkinson's disease patients) were used to validate the derived normative models and demonstrate clinical utility.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Data utilised to derive the normative trajectories is part of the Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory (ABRIM) data collection" ... "To study the applicability of the R2* and χ normative models derived from the ABRIM datasets, an independent cohort with a similar imaging protocol, which is part of the 'Personalized Parkinson Project' (PPP) data collection, was used." ... "Validation of the normative models derived from the ABRIM data was performed by applying the normative models to the PPP cohort."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was built using the ABRIM dataset comprising 260 healthy participants. Gaussian Process Regression with 10-fold cross-validation was employed, but specific train/test split numbers are not reported. The PPP dataset (44 healthy controls) was used only for external validation, not for model training.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Forty-one participants were excluded due to incidental findings and/or did not fulfil the aforementioned criteria, resulting in data of 260 participants to be included in the statistical analysis (18-79 years; mean ± standard deviation (SD) = 50.8 ± 16.8 years, see Table 1 and Supplementary Fig. S1)." ... "Gaussian Process Regression (GRP) ... from PCNToolkit was used to compute the normative trajectory of the sex- and hemispheric-corrected qMRI metrics as a function of age with 10-fold cross-validation."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The ABRIM dataset used for normative modelling comprised 260 healthy participants aged 18-79 years with mean age 50.8 ± 16.8 years. Age distribution was balanced across 6 age bins (18-30, 31-40, 41-50, 51-60, 61-70, 71-79 years). Train-phase specific statistics are not reported due to 10-fold cross-validation methodology.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The ABRIM dataset comprised 141 females (54.2%) and 119 males (45.8%) out of 260 total participants. Sex ratio was balanced throughout the age range. Train-phase specific breakdown is not reported due to 10-fold cross-validation methodology.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "N Male: 119" ... "N Female: 141" (from Table 1). The paper also states the cohort has "an evenly distributed age range (from 18 to 80 years) and sex ratio throughout adulthood."
